Author: FunkyJumbo
Name: Raid Companion
Punchline: Your live DPS, rDPS and party DPS, right in the server info bar.
Description:
Shows your real-time DPS, party DPS or FFLogs-style rDPS in the server info bar, with your rank, role comparison, pace and enrage timer. Includes a live breakdown window, a compact party meter, graphs, pull history with comparisons, GCD analysis, gauge overcap, positionals, combo errors, DoT uptime, overheal, tank swaps, party mitigation, party deaths with their cause, failed mechanics, progression tracking, party DPS checks (built in for extremes and savage raids) and an opener practice for every job. Works on its own, reading the fight straight from the game. Available in English, French and German (and Al Bhed).

Commands:
/raidcompanion (or /rcomp) - open / close the main window
/raidcompanion config - settings
/raidcompanion history - main window on the History tab
/raidcompanion toggle - cycle DPS, pDPS, rDPS
/raidcompanion compact - open / close the compact meter
/raidcompanion opener - open / close the opener practice
/raidcompanion opener compact - opener practice in its compact view
/raidcompanion opener full - opener practice in its full window
/raidcompanion preset <number|name|next> - switch the server bar preset
Changelog:
- Removed: ACT support and the FFLogs percentile. The plugin now only uses its built-in tracker and makes no network connection. FFLogs credentials saved in the settings are deleted.
- DPS and uptime graphs: fixed height, zoom with the mouse wheel (drag to move, double click to reset).
- Positionals: every positional action is shown with how many landed (e.g. 2/2 in green, 2/3 in red after a miss).
- GCD uptime: "Late" and "No GCD" are merged into "No GCD".
- Party table and compact meter: new Crit DH column, the share of hits both critical and direct.
- Live and History: each card can be hidden, and a GCD uptime card can be added (Settings > Display).
- Opener practice: the countdown goes from 5 to 16 s.
- Clipping: a table under the clipping timeline shows each clip with the GCD before, the oGCDs woven and the GCD that came late (new pulls).
- Various UI changes and adjustments.
